name: Pat
source:
From and made of parts unknown, Pat's the end result of awful experimentation and tinkering at the hands of a mad scientist with a not-so hidden lab. Nowadays, Pat spends her time playing babysitter/bodyguard to her creator's spoiled daughter, who sees her more as a wind up toy than a person. Even so, she takes her job seriously and is pretty no nonsense, but once you get to know her, she's actually pretty chill.
